description: Illustrative output event sequence for sample_input.json (semantic VAD on). Text, ids and times are examples.

events._comment: The applied settings. Fields the client omitted show the product's defaults.
Empty deltas before the first text of a turn have item_id null.
With turn detection on, item_id is the turn's server-generated id; with it off, item_id echoes the append event_id.
One per detected turn (only when turn_detection is a VAD object).
item_id is the event_id sent on input_audio_buffer.commit (null when none was sent). audio_processed_ms is the length of the processed audio. The server closes the stream after this event.

invalid_parameters._comment: A rejected transcription_session.update. The session stays open; send a corrected update within 60 s of connecting.

timestamps_unavailable._comment: timestamps: true is not available on this product.

error.message: timestamps are not available for this model at the applied delay. Retry without timestamps.

_notes: Concatenate the delta fields in order to form the full transcript. On this product audio_processed_ms stays 0 on deltas; input_audio_buffer.committed carries the length of the processed audio.
